([[Pinson, Alabama]]) * [[Mountain Brook High School|Mountain Brook]]
([[Mountain Brook, Alabama]]) | college = [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]] (2020–present) | highlights = * [[National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] champion ([[2022 National Invitation Tournament|2022]]) * NIT MVP (2022) * Second-team [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] (2023) * [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman Team (2021) }} '''Colby Everette Jones''' (born May 28, 2002) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier Musketeers]] of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==High school career== Jones played basketball for [[Pinson Valley High School]] in [[Pinson, Alabama]]. As a sophomore, he averaged 23.9 points, 7.9 rebounds and 3.9 assists per game. After a coaching change at Pinson, he transferred to [[Mountain Brook High School]] in [[Mountain Brook, Alabama]] for his junior season to play under coach [[Bucky McMillan]].{{cite web |last1=Grant |first1=Rubin E. |title=Along Came Jones: Talented, Thoughtful Junior Fits in Nicely With the Spartans |url=https://www.otmj.com/colby-jones-mbhs-basketball/ |website=Over the Mountain Journal |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=February 19, 2019}} Jones averaged 14 points, five rebounds and three assists per game as a junior.{{cite web |last1=Bean |first1=Josh |title=Alabama’s top 2020 HS hoops prospect picks Big East school |url=https://www.al.com/recruiting/2019/08/alabamas-top-2020-hs-hoops-prospect-picks-big-east-school.html |website=AL.com |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=August 14, 2019}} He played alongside [[Trendon Watford]] and helped the school win its third straight Class 7A state title. In his senior season, Jones assumed a leading role and averaged 25.2 points, 7.8 rebounds, 3.2 assists and 2.5 steals per game, helping Mountain Brook to a Class 7A runner-up finish.{{cite web |last1=Grant |first1=Rubin E. |title=2020 OTMJ All-OTM High School Boys Basketball Team: Jones Undergoes Life-Changing Experiences Playing for Mountain Brook |url=https://www.otmj.com/2020-otmj-all-otm-boys-basketball/ |website=Over the Mountain Journal |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=March 17, 2020}} He was named ''Over the Mountain Journal'' Player of the Year, All-South Metro Player of the Year and Alabama Class 7A Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Parmley |first1=Kyle |title=All-South Metro Team: Jones named Player of Year |url=https://www.villagelivingonline.com/sports/all-south-metro-team-jones-named-player-of-year/ |website=Village Living |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=March 17, 2020}}{{cite web |last1=Thomas |first1=Ben |title=Meet the state’s 5 best boys HS basketball players for the 2019-2020 season |url=https://www.al.com/highschoolsports/2020/04/meet-the-states-5-best-boys-hs-basketball-players-for-the-2019-2020-season.html |website=AL.com |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=April 1, 2020}} A four-star recruit, he committed to play [[college basketball]] for [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]] over offers from [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]], [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]], [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]] and [[UAB Blazers men's basketball|UAB]]. ==College career== Jones missed the first five games of his freshman season at Xavier due to [[COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19]] [[contact tracing]].{{cite web |last1=Baum |first1=Adam |title='Best hair on the team': Xavier freshman Colby Jones has emerged as an X-factor for the Musketeers |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/xaviersports/2021/01/08/xavier-freshman-colby-jones-has-emerged-major-x-factor/6578662002/ |website=[[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=January 8, 2021}} On January 10, 2021, he made a game-winning three-pointer in the final second of a 74–73 win against [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]].{{cite web |last1=Baum |first1=Adam |title=Xavier's Colby Jones hits a game-winner for his late grandfather |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/college/xavier/xaviersports/2021/01/10/big-east-battle-between-xavier-musketeers-providence-friars/6601557002/ |website=[[The Cincinnati Enquirer]] |access-date=October 23, 2021 |date=January 10, 2021}} On February 16, he scored a season-high 20 points and had six rebounds in a 93–84 loss to [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. John's]].{{cite news |title=Champagnie scores 21 to lift St. John's past Xavier 93-84 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401269650 |access-date=October 24, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=March 1, 2021}} As a freshman, Jones averaged 7.7 points, 4.8 rebounds and 2.9 assists per game, and was selected to the [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman Team.{{cite web |last1=Eiser |first1=Tom |title=Colby Jones Named To BIG EAST Conference All-Freshman Team
